name: Wood Racer
summary: The red racer’s brother, in bare wood.
text:
The same racing shape, with the wood left showing and the number 3 on the side. The wheels and the headlamps light up.

For anyone who prefers raw wood to paint — or who wants both of them on the same shelf.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
